title: Templates: Preview a Template on Any Page Before You Save It | Orchard Core
description:
Checking a Liquid template usually means saving it and then loading the pages that use it.

The Templates module has a Preview button in its editor. It renders a page of your site with the template as it stands in the editor, saved or not, and renders that page again after every change.

In this video:
• How a template is matched by name, and what the preview leaves untouched
• Opening the preview from the Edit Template page
• Following a link to preview another page, then saving the template
• How the editor, the Render action and the shape binding resolver work together
• The permissions and pages the preview needs, and that Admin Templates have no Preview button
